{{Quote|Hmm. An energy weapon that looks like a slugthrower. I didn't think lizards were that nostalgic.|RC-1138|<ref name="Star Wars: Republic Commando">''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]''</ref>}}
The '''Accelerated Charged Particle Array Gun''', commonly known as the '''ACP Array/Scatter Gun''', was a short-range [[Shotgun/Legends|shotgun]] manufactured by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Shotguns? I didn't think anyone used projectile weapons anymore.|RC-1138 first sees the ACP Array gun in use|<ref name="Star Wars: Republic Commando" />}}
The ACP gun was more suited for close quarters combat where extreme blast force was needed. Like all ACP weapons, the Array Gun was more effective against organic targets than [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. The gun could hold up to eight cartridges at a time in its magazine, though more cartridges could be carried by the user, and required manual cocking to move the next round into the chamber.

The Array Gun was just as powerful as the [[Accelerated Charged Particle Repeater Gun|ACP Repeater]] as each particle in the ACP cartridge was the equivalent to one round from the ACP Repeater, although the latter gun had a higher rate of fire. As a result, the array gun performs poorly in open, long range combat, as several slow shots are required to kill an opponent at any great distance. However, in close quarters the array gun generally kills in one shot. According to [[Atin Skirata|Atin]], member of [[Omega Squad]], this weapon dealt better with [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] than [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech]] [[E-Web heavy repeating blaster/Legends|E-Webs]].

The gun had many similarities with the [[Rawk chopped special]] blaster used by [[Cade Skywalker]] and [[Tyber Zann]].

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the weapons were used by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] mercenaries and slavers, as well as [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka's pirates]] and a few [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]]. One was used by the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[T'doshok (bounty hunter)|T'doshok]] on his mission to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Shayla Paige-Tarkin]] of the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]]. The assassin was stopped by [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Fox/Legends|Fox]] of the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]].
